product: MLflow trace storage in Unity Catalog is now generally available
tagline: MLflow trace storage in Unity Catalog tables is now generally available.
what_it_does: MLflow trace storage in Unity Catalog tables is now generally available. Databricks recommends storing traces in Unity Catalog for new and production workloads: storage is unlimited, traces are stored in OpenTelemetry (OTel) format, access is governed through Unity Catalog schema and table permissions, and you can query traces with SQL, Genie, AI/BI dashboards, and any Spark based tool. To view traces, point an MLflow experiment at a Unity Catalog trace location.
